{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for any commas in the revenue column
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

print("Number of rows with commas in revenue:", has_commas.sum())
print("Sample of rows with commas:", df.loc[has_commas, 'revenue'].head())"}
